title: Learning to Design Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.05701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Information designers, such as large language models and online platforms, often do not know the subjective beliefs of their receivers or users. We construct learning algorithms enabling the designer to learn the belief of a strategic receiver through repeated interactions. Our learning algorithms are robust to the receiver's strategic manipulation of the learning process of the designer. We study regret relative to two benchmarks to measure the performance of the algorithms. The static benchmark is $T$ times the single-period optimum for the designer under a known belief. The dynamic benchmark, which is stronger, characterizes global dynamic optimality for the designer under a known belief. Our learning algorithms allow the designer to achieve no regret against both benchmarks at fast convergence speeds of $O(\frac{\log^2 T}{T})$, significantly faster than other approaches in the literature.

translated_abstract: 信息设计者，如大型语言模型和在线平台，往往并不知道其接收者或用户的主观信念。我们构建了学习算法，使设计者能够通过与策略性接收者的重复互动来学习其信念。我们的学习算法对接收者针对设计者学习过程进行的策略性操纵具有鲁棒性。我们通过相对于两个基准的遗憾（regret）来衡量算法的性能。静态基准是已知信念下设计者单期最优收益的 $T$ 倍；动态基准则更强，刻画了已知信念下设计者的全局动态最优性。我们的学习算法使设计者能够以 $O(\frac{\log^2 T}{T})$ 的快速收敛速度在两个基准下均实现无遗憾，显著快于文献中的其他方法。
tldr: 本文构建了对策略性操纵鲁棒的学习算法，使信息设计者能够通过重复互动学习接收者的信念，并以 O(log²T/T) 的快速收敛速度在静态与动态两个基准下均实现无遗憾。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs learning algorithms robust to strategic manipulation that enable information designers to learn receivers' beliefs through repeated interactions, achieving no regret against both static and dynamic benchmarks with fast O(log²T/T) convergence rates.
